name: Haus Leonhard
beschreibung: The Haus Leonhard is situated in the peaceful hamlet of Gmünd near Gerlos in the Zillertal, nestled between lush alpine meadows and rushing mountain streams. The bright rooms and apartments are furnished with native timber and include comfortable bedding and private bathrooms. Guests enjoy a quiet village setting away from through-traffic while remaining just minutes from the vibrant centre of Gerlos and the Durlassboden reservoir. In summer, the location serves as a gateway to high-alpine hiking and mountain biking across the picturesque tributary valleys. In winter, the ski bus quickly whisks winter sports fans to the extensive slopes of the Zillertal Arena.
kurzbeschreibung: Peaceful guesthouse in Gmünd near Gerlos in the Zillertal, surrounded by nature and close to the Zillertal Arena.
